svg.title: About
svg.desc: For three years I was on the other end of the ticket: triaging fifty incidents a day, administering Active Directory and keeping SLAs green for enterprise clients. Near the end I built a Python tool that used a language model to turn prose access requests into directory changes, and I approved every one. Now I'm doing an MSc in AI and Computer Science at Northeastern University London. My dissertation tests guardrails for LLM agents: if a rule blocks one large refund, does the agent split it into many small ones that each pass? I'm open to AI and ML internships, including summer 2027 or an MSc placement, and to full-time roles from February 2027. At a glance: 3+ yrs enterprise IT at Capgemini and Tech Mahindra; 2 to 5 h saved a week by my LLM access tool; 0.99 recall@10 on my RAG assistant; 3.85/4 CGPA, IIIT Bangalore data science.
